events.say: Writing the marker and path pieces.

events.user: Run the checker with the pieces in var/.

events.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path

os.environ["NAME"] = Path("var/name").read_text().strip()
Path(os.environ["BASE"], os.environ["NAME"]).read_bytes()
print(Path("var/mark").read_text().strip())
PY
